# WHO WPRO dengue original

`dengue_20261029.pdf` is the complete original retrieved 2026-11-16 from
https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/wpro---documents/emergency/surveillance/dengue/dengue_20261029.pdf?sfvrsn=fe85de23_1&download=true
linked by the official publication page:
https://www.who.int/westernpacific/publications/m/item/dengue-situation-update---757--29-october-2026

Used for offline contract validation only; this fixture is not a public country
snapshot. Tests preserve explicit seven-day intervals and publication-dated
cumulative snapshots; they do not digitize charts or estimate missing weeks.
